title: AOP2 & SPU XNU Kernel Boundary & Driver Specification

classes.name: AppleAOP2SystemDriver
classes.role: Master host driver attaching to /device-tree/arm-io/aop2; initializes ASCwrap mailbox, establishes RTKit handshake, and spawns endpoint provider nub objects.

classes.name: AppleAOP2KextTightbeamEndpoint
classes.role: Host-side Tightbeam RPC endpoint handler; serializes and dispatches strongly-typed IOPM power assertion requests to AOP2.

classes.name: AppleAOP2IOPMService
classes.role: Interfaces with XNU IOPowerManagement; translates system sleep/wake requests into AOP2 retention assertions.

classes.name: AppleSPUFastpathDriver
classes.role: Manages DMA fast-path ring buffers for 100Hz–800Hz continuous 6-axis IMU streaming without waking AP power domains.

classes.name: AppleSPUALSColorDriver
classes.role: Consumes fixed-point milli-lux telemetry (lux = raw/1000) from AOP2 EP 0x11 and generates TrueTone chromaticity events.

classes.name: AppleSPUDCPDriver
classes.role: Coordinates 1Hz Always-On Display frame buffer updating with AOP2 direct streamer via dcp-control node.

classes.name: AppleSPUHIDDriver
classes.role: Publishes always-on touch, button, and wrist-raise gesture events into the Darwin IOHIDEventSystem framework.

classes.name: AppleAOPAudioLPMicInDevice
classes.role: Directs low-power microphone PDM streams into AOP2 retention SRAM circular buffer for continuous acoustic keyword scoring.

classes.name: AppleAOPAudioRingBuffer
classes.role: Allocates and manages the 3.0-second circular audio history buffer in shared memory.

classes.name: AppleAOPVoiceTriggerUserClient
classes.role: Provides interface for CoreSpeech and assistantd to extract pre-trigger acoustic context upon voice trigger detection.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Attaches client to IMU fastpath queue and maps ring buffer to user space

methods.name: closeStream
methods.description: Detaches client and unmaps DMA buffers

methods.name: configureAODBuffer
methods.description: Sets up 1Hz AOD shared frame buffer address and dimensions

methods.name: getHistoryBuffer
methods.description: Transfers 3.0-second pre-trigger acoustic buffer to userland assistantd

methods.name: setSensitivity
methods.description: Updates on-chip acoustic model threshold parameters
